references.text: Moses gives instructions that the curse should be proclaimed from Mount Ebal, which is the same mountain mentioned in Deuteronomy 27:13.
The preceding verse describes the tribes that are to stand on Mount Gerizim to bless, as a contrast to the six tribes on Ebal for the curse.
Joshua carries out the ceremony at Ebal and Gerizim as Moses had commanded, with the blessings and curses spoken from the two mountains.
Describes the birth of Reuben, who is the first tribe mentioned among the six on Mount Ebal.
Describes the births of Dan, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher—four of the tribes that were to stand on Ebal.
Describes the birth of Zebulun, one of the tribes that was to stand on Mount Ebal for the curse.
